entries.task: Import the operator's brief (docs/planning/brief.md) into docs/planning/solution-plan.md: an objective a reader can act on (keep DabblerPdf rebuildable, testable and republishable by someone who holds no key on any machine, for dabbler-platform's reporting and any other consumer); the Production split the brief answers (not applicable -- a dependency-free library, one module); the Handoff artifact (a NuGet package from `dotnet pack src/DabblerPdf/DabblerPdf.csproj -c Release -o {output}`); the single module DabblerPdf with its responsibility, contract (inputs, guarantees, failure modes), dependency direction (Samples and Tests depend on the library; Tests also reach Samples by project reference) and the cuts deferred; an assessment of the existing DabblerPdf.slnx against the framework's module-per-folder layout (three projects all listed in the slnx and joined by ProjectReference; the Samples project sits at the root rather than under a folder, and the test project references Samples -- both kept, no restructuring proposed); the six decisions the brief asks the plan to make (branches, v1 relics, CI and trusted publishing, dabbler.yaml suite, maintainer guide and policy, release 1.1.3) carried as the operator's leanings for Session 2 to challenge; and the phases -- alignment first (repository hygiene, dabbler.yaml suite fitted to src/tests/Samples), then CI, trusted publishing, maintainer guide, and the 1.1.3 release -- each scoped to a handful of sessions, with what still holds from project-guidance.md and lessons-learned.md noted for import into docs/MAINTAINING.md later.
